This page is generated from the CSV files in `cv_data/`. To update the CV, edit those
files — no HTML editing needed.

<!-- PLACEHOLDER: generate cv.pdf separately and drop it in the project root to enable
     this download button; delete the button if you don't want a static copy. -->

[Download PDF](cv.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-sm role="button"}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(readr)

# gt makes nicer HTML tables; fall back to knitr::kable if it isn't installed.
has_gt <- requireNamespace("gt", quietly = TRUE)

cv_table <- function(path, col_labels) {
  df <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  names(df) <- col_labels
  if (has_gt) {
    gt::gt(df) |>
      gt::tab_options(
        table.width = gt::pct(100),
        table.font.size = gt::pct(95),
        # Inherit the site's body font (set in editorial.scss) instead of gt's default.
        table.font.names = c("Source Sans 3", "system-ui", "sans-serif"),
        column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
        table.border.top.style = "none",
        data_row.padding = gt::px(6)
      )
  } else {
    knitr::kable(df)
  }
}
```

## Positions

```{r}
#| label: positions
#| echo: false

cv_table(
  "cv_data/positions.csv",
  c("From", "To", "Position", "Institution", "Description")
)
```
